name: Temple Priest Objector
background: An elite Sadducean priest who views any popular religious movement as a threat. Objects to teaching on resurrection.

genericReactions.physical: This is irrelevant. The only thing that matters is the Law of Sinai.
genericReactions.testimonial: His claims are blasphemy. There is no other interpretation.
genericReactions.digital: The Law is our only record. All else is commentary.
genericReactions.environmental: The Temple has stood for generations. It will not be threatened by one man.
genericReactions.analytical: You cannot quantify holiness or blasphemy. The Law is absolute.
genericReactions.prophecy: He is not the one the prophets spoke of. He is a lawbreaker.
